LanguageData.RHAH_Gene_ThinRations.label: small appetite
LanguageData.RHAH_Gene_ThinRations.description: Carriers of this gene have a smaller appetite. Their maximum food need is 85% of normal.
LanguageData.RHAH_Gene_LargeLitter.label: large litter
LanguageData.RHAH_Gene_LargeLitter.description: Carriers of this gene can give birth to several children at once. The minimum, most likely count, and maximum can be changed in the mod settings.
LanguageData.RHAH_Gene_LargeLitter.customEffectDescri: Litter size can be changed in the mod settings
Counts closer to the configured peak are more likely
LanguageData.RHAH_Gene_EarlyFertility.label: early fertility
LanguageData.RHAH_Gene_EarlyFertility.description: Carriers of this gene become fertile earlier. Both partners must reach the minimum biological age selected in the mod settings.
LanguageData.RHAH_Gene_EarlyFertility.customEffectDes: Minimum fertile age can be changed in the mod settings
Both partners must reach that biological age
Minimum fertile age setting: 1 to 14 years
LanguageData.RHAH_Gene_HighFertility.label: high fertility
LanguageData.RHAH_Gene_HighFertility.description: Carriers of this gene are more likely to become pregnant or make a partner pregnant. The pregnancy chance multiplier can be set from 1 to 10 times normal.
LanguageData.RHAH_Gene_HighFertility.customEffectDesc: Pregnancy chance multiplier can be changed in the mod settings
LanguageData.RHAH_Gene_RoomFertility.label: room fertility
LanguageData.RHAH_Gene_RoomFertility.description: Carriers of this gene initiate lovin' with someone of the other gender resting in the same non-medical bed indoors, once both partners' lovin' cooldowns have passed, even without a romantic relationship. Pregnancy can follow, including while lactating. Both partners must be at least 1 biological year old. The chance also depends on both partners' fertility and the mod settings.
LanguageData.RHAH_Gene_RoomFertility.customEffectDesc: Initiates lovin' with someone of the other gender in the same non-medical bed indoors once both partners' cooldowns have passed
Base pregnancy chance defaults to 50% and can be changed in the mod settings
Both partners must be at least 1 biological year old
LanguageData.RHAH_Gene_FastBirth.label: short pregnancy
LanguageData.RHAH_Gene_FastBirth.description: Carriers of this gene have shorter pregnancies. The duration can be set between 3 and 5.661 days, and is also limited by the species' own gestation period.
LanguageData.RHAH_Gene_FastBirth.customEffectDescript: Pregnancy duration can be changed in the mod settings
Maximum: 5.661 days or the species' own gestation period, whichever is shorter
